title: 第一卷 第5章 这辈子，我还是当个人，积点德吧！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

暴雨倾盆。

站在村委会二楼的窗口，一眼望去，全都是水，就如同置身于孤岛。

闫耀宗扭头看向还睡在两张办公桌上的傻婆娘，脸上不由得露出温柔的笑容。

媳妇儿，这辈子，我就守着你、护着你、宠着你。

好似感觉到的闫耀宗的目光，熟睡中的傻婆娘，眼珠子在眼皮下边转动，慢慢地睁开眼皮。

四目相视。

傻婆娘脸上露出憨憨的笑容。

闫耀宗缓步走到傻婆娘面前，弯下腰，鼻尖凑到她眼前，柔声笑道：“媳妇，等会儿我要去镇里一趟，你乖乖待在这里，别乱跑！”

“不乱跑，媳妇不乱跑！”傻婆娘笑起来脸颊上的两个小梨涡格外明显，眼睛就好似弯弯的月牙儿。

“真乖！”

闫耀宗抬手轻轻地刮了下傻婆娘的粉鼻。

暴雨倾盆，闫耀宗身上裹着油布，离开村委会。

闫振东坐在屋门旁，看着屋外哗啦啦的暴雨，嘴里边叼着卷烟，寻思着闫耀宗昨晚的话。

他跟闫耀宗从小一起长大，非常了解对方的性子。

昨天的闫耀宗，就好似变了个人，还说要带他去镇里赚钱。

现在云海市暴雨不断，哪有什么赚钱的活儿？

“耀宗！”

陡然，闫振东看到一道身影，冒着大雨，从远处走来。

闫耀宗裹着油布，走到门口处，看着站起身来的闫振东，咧嘴一笑，“考虑的怎么样？”

“没啥好考虑的。”闫振东笑了笑，弯腰拿起早就准备好的蓑衣雨帽，道：“家里粮食不多了，我陪你一起去镇里！”

闫振东没说答不答应，只是跟着去镇里。

“行。那咱们走吧！”

“嗯！”

闫振东手脚麻利地穿上蓑衣，戴上雨帽。

“你们两个小兔崽子，路上小心点。要是路真被冲垮了，就赶紧回来！”闫抗美满脸担忧地走上前，叮嘱道。

“叔，你就放心吧。路真要冲垮，我们肯定不会逞强！”闫耀宗道。

“爸，我们又不是小孩子了！”闫振东穿好蓑衣，嘟囔一句，旋即向着屋外走去，一边说道，“耀宗，咱们走吧！”

俩人一前一后，向着上闫村外走去。

闫耀宗眯着眼睛，眺望着远处。

田地都被淹没，今年的双季旱稻算是废了。

闫耀宗走在前边，手里边拿着两米长的竹竿，戳着前面的水面。

雨太大，俩人都没有说话，闷头走着。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It rained heavily.

Standing at the window on the second floor of the village committee, all you can see is water, as if you are on an isolated island.

Yan Yaozong turned to look at the silly woman who was still sleeping on the two desks, and couldn't help but reveal a gentle smile on his face.

Wife, in this life, I will guard you, protect you, and pamper you.

As if feeling Yan Yaozong's gaze, the sleeping silly woman's eyes rolled under her eyelids and slowly opened her eyelids.

Looking into each other's eyes.

A silly smile appeared on the silly woman's face.

Yan Yaozong walked slowly to the silly woman, bent down, put the tip of his nose in front of her eyes, and said with a soft smile: "Daughter-in-law, I'm going to the town later, please stay here and don't run around!"

"If you don't run around, my wife won't run around!" The silly woman smiled and the two small pear dimples on her cheeks were particularly obvious, and her eyes were like crescent moons.

"So good!"

Yan Yaozong raised his hand and gently scraped the silly woman's pink nose.

It rained heavily, and Yan Yaozong left the village committee wrapped in oilcloth.

Yan Zhendong sat by the door of the house, looking at the heavy rain outside, holding a cigarette in his mouth, thinking about what Yan Yaozong said last night.

He and Yan Yaozong grew up together and knew each other's temperament very well.

Yesterday, Yan Yaozong seemed to have changed. He also said that he would take him to the town to make money.

Now that there are constant heavy rains in Yunhai City, how can there be any money-making work?

"Yao Zong!"

Suddenly, Yan Zhendong saw a figure walking from a distance in the heavy rain.

Yan Yaozong was wrapped in oilcloth and walked to the door. He looked at Yan Zhendong who stood up and grinned, "How do you think about it?"

"There's nothing to think about." Yan Zhendong smiled, bent down and picked up the raincoat and rain hat that he had prepared long ago, and said: "We don't have much food at home, I will go to town with you!"

Yan Zhendong didn't say whether he would agree or not, he just followed him to the town.

"Okay. Let's go then!"

"Yeah!"

Yan Zhendong quickly put on his raincoat and rain hat.

"You two little bastards, be careful on the road. If the road is really washed out, come back quickly!" Yan Kangmei stepped forward with a worried look on his face and warned.

"Uncle, don't worry. If the road is really going to collapse, we will definitely not be brave!" Yan Yaozong said.

"Dad, we are not children anymore!" Yan Zhendong put on his raincoat, muttered, and immediately walked out of the house, saying, "Yao Zong, let's go!"

The two of them walked towards the outside of Shangyan Village, one behind the other.

Yan Yaozong squinted his eyes and looked into the distance.

The fields are all submerged, and this year's double-cropping upland rice is considered useless.

Yan Yaozong was walking in front, holding a two-meter-long bamboo pole in his hand, poking at the water in front of him.

The rain was too heavy, so neither of them spoke and just walked in silence.
